summary.text: Bride Sweeney, listed by the Ohio House as Bride Rose Sweeney, is a Democratic member of the Ohio House of Representatives, representing District 16 in western Cuyahoga County. Her official biography says she is serving her fourth term, was first elected in November 2018, and is Ranking Member of the House Finance Committee.

paragraphs.text: The House biography says Sweeney attended Saint Joseph Academy and John Carroll University, where she earned a bachelor of arts and studied political science, business and leadership.

It says she then joined the Legislative Service Commission Fellowship and, before her election, worked in the Ohio Senate, including as a senior advisor to the Minority Leader and a legislative aide to Senator Lou Gentile.
According to the biography, Sweeney was the first woman to represent her district at the Statehouse and the youngest Democratic member of the 133rd General Assembly when elected in 2018.
It says she was the lead Democratic sponsor of the bipartisan Fair School Funding Plan, which became law on July 1, 2021, and that she serves on the State Controlling Board.
It says Cleveland.com named her its Democratic Rising Star for five consecutive years and that she was named Most Bipartisan Lawmaker in 2023.
